ai_summary: Anthem Biosciences Limited has formally intimated an earnings conference call scheduled for November 4, 2026, at 12:30 PM IST. The call, a standard regulatory disclosure under SEBI's Listing Obligations, will cover the company's unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 & H1 FY27). This announcement itself carries no immediate material financial impact or red flags, serving solely as a precursor to the release of key performance indicators.
